findings_and_limits.observation: The test includes a blank provider METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN value and the title says blank provider values are ignored, but it does not explicitly assert the resulting METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN remains absent. The current resolver code checks hasConfiguredValue before copying; this round records a test assertion gap, not an observed source failure.

The tests verify unit contracts with mocked Vault/config/command dependencies and synthetic streams. They do not prove Vault integration, transaction serialization against PostgreSQL, actual HTTP request parsing or server response behavior.

Leave production/runtime Vault and database verification to an approved isolated boundary.
